page.overview:
Who is Clemain Astural?

Clemain Astural was a powerful arcanist who lived during the Age of Arcanum. According to legend, he was known as the Sight Shepherd and went mad after a pact with an otherworldly entity he called The Sightless, who fueled his power. This power allowed Clemain to devastate southeastern Tal'Dorei until he was defeated, buried in the rubble of his tower, Wrettis.

According to legend, after encountering The Sightless, Astural was driven mad and wrote pages of paranoid, half-crazed ramblings.

Clemain Astural lived during the Age of Arcanum. According to the few legends that survived history, known as the Sight Shepherd, he was a powerful arcanist who had peered into a realm beyond the Planes of Existence in search of power that would allow him to cease war around the world. He found an entity he called The Sightless, whom he made an agreement with, mistakenly believing that The Sightless would serve him. Astural's sanity subsequently crumbled, but his power, fueled by The Sightless, grew, allowing the mage to sweep devastation over southeastern Tal'Dorei.

During his reign, Astural wrote thousands of pages of parchment with writings that would later become known as the Astural Scrolls. Earlier notes ranged from alchemical formulas, spells, and star charts, but his later notes descended into paranoid ramblings. At some point, Astural made his tower, Wrettis, his base of operations, containing his secret creations.
